nodes.text: 測試過的好品質 - 求婚篇｜IKEA Hong Kong

【求婚】動詞 一種介乎喺驚喜😍同驚嚇😱之間嘅行為 心情大上大落，坐又唔係，企又唔係，點揀至好？ IKEA梳化座椅大膽建議：揀我先～ 通過5萬次重壓測試，支撐起你所有嘅坐立不安。 而家精選梳化仲低至8折起，快啲嚟IKEA出手搶購啦：https://bit.ly/3nq9t2g 了解更多測試過的好品質：https://bit.ly/38nxZgj #測試過的好品質 #忐忑在KIVIK梳化上 #係驚喜定驚嚇 #係愛呀 #心意隨著POÄNG搖曳 #坐又唔係企又唔係 #人生重要一幕 #SheSaidYes 【Propose】Verb An act that is both exciting and frightening. It’s quite an emotional roller coaster – one moment you’ll feel like jumping up with joy, the next you might need to sit down in shock. IKEA sofas and armchairs have a suggestion: Only perform this action when we’re close by! We’ve been weight-tested over 50,000 times, so we can support you no matter how many times you go up and down. IKEA’s selected living room seating is now up to 20% off. Come visit IKEA to save more and enjoy more(https://bit.ly/3osV3zI)!
